2122519172664209692.en_summary: $GOOGL Threat Intelligence Group: “The era of autonomous attacks has arrived”. Fully autonomous vulnerability exploitation is now happening. Adversaries transitioned beyond manual prompting to deploying autonomous multi-agent offensive frameworks. AI is collapsing the window between vulnerability disclosure and exploitation. Google believes cybersecurity defense must become autonomous too by combining Gemini and other frontier models for reasoning + smaller models for continuous scanning. Beneficiaries of this arms race are AI compute and infra providers, regardless of the cybersecurity winners. Since cybersecurity will become a source of persistent inference consumption. $AMZN CEO Andy Jassy's also quoted estimates earlier that 20% of AI tokens could go toward cybersecurity. The rise of persistent cyberattacks from hostile state actors is a structural driver for long term compute demand.
2122519172664209692.zh_summary: $GOOGL 威脅情報小組：「自主攻擊的時代已經到來」。完全自主的漏洞利用正在發生。對手從手動提示過渡到部署自主多代理攻擊框架。AI正在縮小漏洞披露和利用之間的窗口。Google認為網絡安全防禦也必須變得自主，通過結合Gemini和其他前沿模型進行推理 + 較小模型進行連續掃描。這場軍備競賽的受益者是AI計算和基礎設施提供商，無論網絡安全贏家是誰。因為網絡安全將成為持續推理消耗的來源。$AMZN CEO Andy Jassy之前也引用估計，20%的AI令牌可能用於網絡安全。來自敵對國家行為者的持續網絡攻擊的興起是長期計算需求的結構性驅動因素。
